title: Successor start-record identity
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-tape Turing machine with $k$ tapes, let $n,T,t,	ext{lt}$ be natural numbers, and let $z$ be a finite Boolean list. Set $S=k(2T+1)+|z|+n+3$. The start record at step $t+1$ has $q$-coordinate $(t+1)S-S$, so replacing that coordinate by $(t+1)S-S$ leaves the record unchanged.
